items.title: Dick Sherman interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, June 1, 2006
items.q: The interviewee addresses the interviewer as 'Monk' (referring to Monk Rowe) throughout the transcript, but there is no evidence of a personal relationship, collaboration, or specific interaction beyond the interview setting.

ctx.x: Okay Sherm. It’s a pleasure to have you here on your annual trek to Hamilton for you guys.
Fifty years, that’s amazing. And it says here, in print, that you are the nation’s longest playing alumni band.
